description: This source file defines the 'repositories/commit.go' component in Go, which encapsulates database interactions related to commit data within a project. It includes types and functions for inserting, querying, and retrieving commit information, along with handling null objects and specific SQL operations.

classes.name: NullCommit
classes.description: A null object implementation of the commit repository interface, used for handling errors or default cases without performing any database operations.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: Represents a database-backed repository for handling commit data, capable of inserting and retrieving commit information from the database.

methods.name: InsertCommitRows
methods.description: Inserts a list of analyzed commit rows into the database.

methods.name: GetFirstSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the earliest timestamp for a list of commit hashes, returning a map from commit hash to timestamp.

methods.name: GetMostRecentCommits
methods.description: Fetches the most recent commit entries from the database.

methods.name: GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Gets the latest timestamp and UUID for commits related to the specific target.

methods.name: WithTimestampGenerator
methods.description: Returns a new Commit object with a specified timestamp generator function.
